module: Queries the state of the BeamNG.tech (research) and commercial licenses through the C++ objects ResearchVerifier and CommercialVerifier, with a per-session cache. Used to filter BeamNG.tech-only input map and action files (paths containing "_beamng.tech") when the license is not valid. For a modder, it is mostly useful to know whether the game is running with a tech/commercial license.
notes: Results are cached in stateCache on first read and never refreshed: a license change during the session is not seen.
If ResearchVerifier (or CommercialVerifier) does not exist, isValid (resp. isCommercial) returns false without caching.
The path filter is a simple search for the substring "_beamng.tech" in the path.

isValid.desc: Returns whether the BeamNG.tech license is verified (ResearchVerifier.isTechLicenseVerified).

returns.desc: false without a verifier or without a license.

isCommercial.desc: Returns whether the license is commercial (CommercialVerifier.isCommercialLicense).

returns.desc: false without a verifier or without a license.

requestState.desc: Sends the tech license state to the UI via guihooks (TechLicenseState).

isAllowedInputmapPath.desc: Tells whether it is relevant to load this input map: always true with a valid tech license, otherwise false if the path contains "_beamng.tech".
